annotations.title: Asset loan payment and after-tax cost

description: Calculates the exact monthly payment, total interest and first-year interest for an equipment, truck, tractor, RV, land, manufactured home, ATV, pontoon or other asset loan, and, for business assets, the after-tax cost: first-year tax saving from the Section 179 or bonus deduction plus deductible interest at your marginal rate, first-year net cash, and lifetime after-tax cost. Pair it with calculate_section_179 for the deduction amount.

asset_type.description: Type of asset, used to link the matching calculator page.

business_use_percent.description: Business use share 0-100. Give this or marginal_tax_rate to get the after-tax cost.

first_year_deduction.description: Section 179 plus bonus deduction taken in year 1. Defaults to the full business share of the price.

marginal_tax_rate.description: Combined marginal tax rate as a decimal, e.g. 0.30.

name: calculate_asset_loan_payment
title: Asset loan payment and after-tax cost
